# Contributing to Broccoli Access

> **We don't accept outside pull requests yet.** Pull requests are open to the
> maintainers only. Broccoli Access stays open source: you can read, run and fork the
> code.

The best way to help is a detailed issue: the problem, who it affects, and how
you expect Broccoli Access to behave. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/getbroccoli/broccoli-access/issues)
first.

For security problems, don't open an issue; follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
